chi_tiet.mo_ta:
In the darkest corners of our planet, life takes on impossible shapes.
Miles below the surface, where sunlight never reaches, strange creatures survive under crushing pressure and freezing blackness. From glowing predators to transparent hunters, these life forms shouldn’t exist — yet they do.
Scientists are only beginning to understand how evolution created such monsters of the deep.
🌊 In this episode, we explore the most mysterious deep-sea creatures ever discovered, their bizarre adaptations, and the haunting world they call home.
